# Documentation completeness audit

## Goal

Audit and confirm all documentation reflecting the destructive-commit incident (SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ) and the test-isolation guard (SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42) is in place and accurate — AC5 of the parent item.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC5 — All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes: docstring, code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries are checked and updated where needed.
- Class docstring in `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest` mentions the incident date, commit `2c30dbfe`, and the guard rationale.
- Inline comments in `_init_repo` reference SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42 and explain the practical git-operation surface.
- Regression test `test_init_repo_refuses_live_repo_tmp_path` has a descriptive docstring.
- A summary comment records what was checked and what (if anything) was updated.
## Key Files

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — docstring, comments, regression test.
